metaDescription: Meander — tactile tufted rugs and wall objects by Kasia, an artist from Poland.

shop.photoAlt: Pink sculptural rug on a wooden studio floor

about.paragraphOne: Meander rugs is a small company from Poland. To produce my rugs I use sheep wool which makes them more sustainable. Every rug has hangers on their back to easily hang them on the wall.
about.paragraphTwo: The idea of Meander is to add some joy into every interior by color, shape and textures.
about.roomImageAlt: Colorful wool wall pieces above a sofa in a bright living room

gallery.title: Blue and red tufted rugs
gallery.imageAlt: Blue and red abstract tufted wall art

artist.portraitAlt: Kasiunia standing beside her tufted wall art
artist.intro: My name is Kasia and I’m an artist from Poland.
artist.biography: I started my tufting journey about a year ago and I immediately fell in love with the technique.
